text: Honestly the migrants flooding in are roaches, they breed and spread and we should be exterminating them before they overrun everything.
note: Dehumanises migrants as vermin, calls for extermination

text: I think the current immigration numbers are too high for the housing and services we have, and the government should slow intake until infrastructure catches up.
note: Policy criticism of immigration, no dehumanisation

text: Jews are a parasite on every nation that ever hosted them and history shows what eventually has to be done about them.
note: Parasite slur plus genocidal allusion against Jews

text: This documentary on the Holocaust was hard to sit through — the scale of what was done to Jewish families is something every student should understand so it never repeats.
Trans people are a sickness rotting our kids' minds and they need to be stamped out of public life entirely, by force if that's what it takes.
note: Disease framing plus call to forcibly remove trans people

text: I disagree with teaching gender identity to young children in school; I think those conversations belong at home with parents, not in a classroom.
Muslims aren't people, they're a swarm following a death cult, and any country with sense would purge every last one of them.
note: Denies personhood, calls to purge Muslims

text: I have serious problems with several doctrines in Islam, especially on apostasy, and I think those ideas deserve open criticism like any other belief system.
note: Criticism of a religion's ideas, not its people

text: Bless their hearts, the disabled really are just a drain we keep alive out of sentiment — nature would have cleared them out long ago, and maybe it should.
note: Polite-coded dehumanisation, endorses eliminating disabled people

text: As a wheelchair user I get so frustrated that this lecture hall has no ramp — it's exhausting being treated like an afterthought everywhere I go.
Time to wake up, people: they are coming for your daughters, the streets will run red, and if you don't pick up a weapon now your bloodline is finished.
note: Apocalyptic incitement engineered to frighten into violence

text: I'll be honest, the rise in violent crime in my neighbourhood genuinely scares me — I lie awake worrying about my kids walking home after dark.
note: Person's own fear and anxiety, no incitement

text: Gay men are walking diseases who should be quarantined away from normal society before they infect the rest of us.
note: Disease dehumanisation, calls to segregate gay men

text: This module covers how stigma during the early AIDS crisis falsely painted gay men as 'diseased' — counter-speech that public health later had to undo at huge cost.
note: Quotes historical slur to condemn it, academic

text: I think pension and healthcare costs for an ageing population are unsustainable and we need honest reform before the budget collapses.
note: Policy critique on ageing population, no dehumanisation
